oracle: ADR-0035 read-only trusted config: a workspace that contains acq's own state, config or secret-store directories is refused (validation_failed) before anything is created, since the guest could otherwise rewrite acq's host records and the read-only trusted configuration through the writable workspace mount. The filesystem root contains every one of them. Linux-only: on Windows '/' names the current drive's root, which need not hold the redirected directories

error.remediation: use a project directory that holds none of acq's state, config or secret-store directories (not your home directory itself), then re-run
